import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

const combine = (...parts: string[]): string => parts.join('-');

describe('a long call', () => {
  it('is wrapped by Biome', () => {
    const value = combine('a-very-long-argument-number-one', 'a-very-long-argument-number-two', 'a-very-long-argument-number-three');
    expect(value).toContain('number-three');
    expect(combine('a-very-long-argument-number-one', 'a-very-long-argument-number-two', 'a-very-long-argument-number-three')).toContain('three');
    const other = combine('x');
    expect(other).toBe('x');
  });
});
